description: parcs.at: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by parcs.at. Coverage: the area served by parcs.at. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Does street lighting change the composition of arthropod communities?; Last mile - Analysis of the technical state-of-the-art of regional pub; Analysing the impact of drivers and pressures on the conservation goal. Formats seen: PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
